author: Kusha N M
raw:
ವೇದವಿದ್ದರೆಯೇನು ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರಗಳಿರಲೇನು
ಆದೇಶ ನೀಡುವಾ ಸ್ಥಾನವಿರಲೇನು
ನಾದ ನಾಟ್ಯವು ನಟನೆ ಸ್ಮೃತಿಯಿದ್ದರೇನು
ಮಾದರಿಯೆ ಇಲ್ಲದಿರೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: What if you have the Veda? What if you have the śāstras?
what if you hold a position to give orders?
what if you have music, dance, acting and learning by heart,
if there is no example in you, O deluded one?
en.bhavartha: Knowledge, authority and talent count for little if we are not ourselves a good example. Living well teaches more than anything we know.
